patthana15.14:1.1: hetuṃ hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.14:2.1: nahetuṃ majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.14:3.1: hetuṃ paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuduka micchattattike nahetuduka namicchattatikaṃ
